scope: Autonomous orchestration infrastructure; no Tariff product feature or production database change

commands.context: Implementation at reviewed_implementation_sha plus the two independent test cases committed with this report

independent_fault_injection: Failure after atomic task-board write but before companion projections: separate Python process restores the durable task and all projection revisions without duplicate launch permission
Tamper an otherwise complete persisted READY record to make the function author its QA reviewer: separate Python process rejects recovery with independent_qa_required

review_findings.finding: Persisted READY accepted no branch, worktree, QA, audit or CI
review_findings.validation: Reproduced with pure-memory validate_board input before fix; command exited zero
review_findings.resolution: Fixed: persisted readiness validates exact commit, independent sessions, tests, audit disposition and CI provenance; regression executed

review_findings.finding: Completed task retained file ownership indefinitely
review_findings.resolution: Fixed: explicit verified integration handoff releases ownership without deleting a branch or worktree; dependency content checked

review_findings.finding: External audit pass accepted an arbitrary string evidence reference
review_findings.resolution: Fixed: bound provider receipt, packet hash and A0 adjudication required; missing configuration stays explicitly UNAVAILABLE

review_findings.finding: Generic unittest discovery can pass an empty suite
review_findings.resolution: Fixed: deterministic runner requires each core test module and nonzero discovered cases; workflow invokes it

review_findings.finding: Expired crashed coordinator had no autonomous verified takeover path
review_findings.resolution: Fixed: CAS takeover requires expired lease and current platform termination evidence; expiry alone cannot authorize takeover

evidence_limits.security_boundary: Worktrees, coordinator policy and cooperating-session CAS do not sandbox OS privileges or enforce GitHub server permissions

publication_rule: This report is supporting local A5 evidence. Any final integration or remotely published SHA requires its own exact-head checks. No merge or production approval is implied.
